ask: Why is it on the path?
cards: The founder of the Persian empire, remembered as much for tolerance as for conquest.
Master of the ancient world by thirty-two, dead a year later; the empire broke, the Greek century it opened did not.
Gaul conquered, the Republic broken: the general whose name became a title on three continents.
The Hun who bled two Roman empires and vanished with his realm within a decade.
From orphan of the steppe to ruler of the largest land empire in history.
The last great steppe conqueror, builder of Samarkand and destroyer of nearly everyone else.
Lawgiver to the Ottomans and terror of Europe, at the summit of a dynasty's power.
The artillery officer who crowned himself emperor and forced all Europe to reorganise against him.
